messages:
ashley: Heads-up — noticed a short burst of high-volume SELECTs against production.users_table from the analytics service account (sa-analytics@redwood-prod). ~12k rows read/min for ~3m. Not expected. :eyes:
sec-bot: [ALERT] unusual-read-rate detected for service-account sa-analytics@redwood-prod on host db-primary-01 at 2026-08-01T14:12:09Z (rule: read-rate-spike)
mike: Can you paste the query pattern? Any exports to S3 or external endpoints?
ashley: Query sample:
```
SELECT id, email, created_at FROM users WHERE created_at >= '2025-01-01' ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 10000;
```
ashley: I pulled the DB audit logs — there are repeated runs from an instance with IP 35.203.12.45 and the app user is sa-analytics. No direct S3 PUTs in the logs, but many large COPYTO statements in the query plan (we do use COPY TO from analytics app occasionally).
devon: That IP is one of our GKE nodes in analytics-prod. Could be a scheduled job misconfigured. Did it use a rotated key or older creds?
azara: Quick check: KMS logs show a decrypt call for key projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/analytics/cryptoKeys/sa-key by service-account sa-analytics@redwood-prod at 2026-08-01T14:11:58Z. :lock:
mike: Ok mark as INCIDENT-INVESTIGATION. @sec-oncall, can you temporarily disable the SA key and block outbound network egress for the pod? We should contain.
sec-oncall: On it. Disabling key now and adding egress deny for pod-selector analytics-batch. Will follow up when done.
dev-bot: Action executed: KMS key disabled (key: analytics/sa-key). NetworkPolicy updated to block egress for pods with label app=analytics-batch. (run-id: 8cf2b4)
ashley: After containment, read rate dropped back to baseline. No evidence of external exfil. Still need root cause — likely a scheduled job that escalated query scope.
mike: Next steps: 1) rotate the SA key, 2) run RBAC check for sa-analytics permissions + bound roles, 3) review scheduled cronjobs in k8s for that namespace, 4) increase audit retention for DB query logs to 90 days. Assign owners?
azara: I'll handle KMS rotate and audit retention. ETA 2h.
devon: I'll audit k8s cronjobs and search repo for jobs referencing sa-analytics. ETA 1h.
ashley: I'll open an incident ticket and attach the extracted queries + timelines. Incident ID: INC-20260801-17
mike: Good. Add a postmortem owner please. Also recommended immediate RBAC change: remove privilege >reader+ on users table for analytics service account until job is fixed.
sec-oncall: Logged action items in the ticket and set severity to P2. Scheduling postmortem for tomorrow 10:00am PT. :calendar:
ashley: Thanks all. Will post final timeline and remediation in the ticket once done. :white_check_mark:
